children: Salesforce posted an Investor Day presentation detailing FY27 guidance, financial targets and its path to $63B+ FY30 revenue.
Posted Investor Day deck covering financial performance, guidance, growth targets, market opportunity and economic model.
FY27 revenue guidance cited at the high end of $46.1–$46.4B and non-GAAP operating margin guidance as of Aug 2026.
On track to $63B+ FY30 revenue target (implying ~11%+ CAGR FY26–FY30, includes Informatica and announced M&A).
Free cash flow growth shown: FY26 free cash flow $14.4B and on track to ~3x since FY22; FY27 FCF guidance noted (non-GAAP).
Capital allocation priorities: $25B ASR, expected ≥14% share count reduction and $60B+ cumulative shareholder returns to date.
